name: Transit Zones
description:
This dataset defines transit zones as geographic areas, with each record listing a zone name and the length and area of its boundary shape. The zone field includes five categories: Beyond the Greater Transit Zone, Outer Transit Zone, Inner Transit Zone, Manhattan Core and Long Island City Parking Provisions, and Special 25-241 Parking Provisions. The length and area fields are numeric measurements of each zone's polygon, ranging from roughly 229,000 to 2.8 million in length and about 270 million to 3.9 billion in area.

The data serves as a small spatial reference layer for land-use and urban planning. It can be used to map transit zone boundaries, compare the size of zones, and support zoning or development analysis. It can also be joined with housing, transportation, or parcel datasets to study how regulations or planning policies differ across transit zones.
